senses.gloss: ūrmi, m. or f. (in this sense AMg. ummi, see Ratnach., but not Skt. ūrmi, Pali ūmi, ummi), crowd, throng (of creatures): Mv 〔i.222.14〕 = 〔ii.24.22〕 samantormijātā, forming a crowd all around (here of gods); LV 〔173.13〕 (vs) naṭaraṅgasamā jagi-r-ūrmi-cuti, like an actorʼs stage-set is the passing of the crowd (of people) in the world; so if Lefm.ʼs text is right, but v.l. janmi for r-ūrmi, which (or rather janma) seems supported by Tib. skye.
